question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: four requests, the reproducibility.command of the 2026-09-20 record run verbatim, sections (R1) to (R4) of the artifact, sent 06:13:26Z to 06:13:29Z: GET the merchant's /.well-known/ucp; then, to the shopping endpoint it names, a bare tools/list with no initialize, a tools/call of create_checkout carrying the vendor's own published example agent profile and one line item whose product variant id is gid://shopify/ProductVariant/0, an id that cannot exist, and the same tools/call shape for get_order as a control. No Authorization header, no HTTP signature, no cookie jar, no payment.

decoded.discovery: (R1) 200, 6,754 bytes as received, shown up to 6,000 with the endpoint and version counted over the whole body: the document names version 2026-08-25, supported_versions 2026-04-08 and 2026-01-23 at versioned well-known paths on the myshopify.com host, a dev.ucp.shopping service over MCP at https://1da1f2-7c.myshopify.com/api/ucp/mcp (one entry per version, same endpoint), and ten capability keys: dev.shopify.catalog, dev.ucp.common.identity_linking, dev.ucp.shopping.cart, .catalog.lookup, .catalog.search, .checkout, .discount, .fulfillment, .order and .permalink. The 2026-09-20 record named six (checkout, cart, fulfillment, discount, order, catalog); whether the document listed the other keys that day is not recorded there, so this record states today's list and does not date the difference.
decoded.tools-list: (R2) 200, 179,717 bytes as received, shown up to 2,500 and counted whole: 13 tools by occurrences of inputSchema, named cancel_cart, cancel_checkout, complete_checkout, create_cart, create_checkout, get_cart, get_checkout, get_order, get_product, lookup_catalog, search_catalog, update_cart, update_checkout: the same thirteen as on 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-29. No www-authenticate header on this or any other response here.
decoded.create-checkout: (R3) 200, 10,110 bytes as received and shown whole, isError true, and a UCP envelope of status error with one message: type error, code invalid, severity unrecoverable, path $.line_items[0].item.id, content 'The merchandise with id gid://shopify/ProductVariant/0 does not exist.' Its continue_url is the storefront root, https://1da1f2-7c.myshopify.com/. No authentication error of any kind, and no checkout: the call passed the credential check and failed at merchandise validation, exactly as on 2026-09-20.
decoded.control-get-order: (R4) HTTP 403, 2,288 bytes as received, JSON-RPC error -32000 AuthenticationRequired, 'Unauthorized: A valid JWT is required to call get_order', before any argument of the call is validated: the same refusal as on 2026-09-20 and as the thirteen-tool pass of 2026-09-29.
decoded.why-re-sent: Re-sent 2026-10-10 because the record of these requests from 2026-09-20 (p-20260920-shopify-ucp-checkout-anonymous) was filed before this prober kept transcripts and names no artifact; this one does, with a sent line per request from date -u in the command that sent it. Its sibling of the same day, p-20260920-shopify-ucp-tool-auth-gate, is not re-sent: its thirteen calls were re-run with a per-second stamp each in Part B of evidence/shopify-ucp/2026-09-29/probes-0621Z.txt (p-20260929-shopify-ucp-profile-gate). Nothing measured here changed since 2026-09-20.
decoded.not-measured: whether a well-formed anonymous create_checkout succeeds was not tested, because that would create a session on a merchant's store; no cart, checkout, order or payment was created. One merchant endpoint is one merchant's configuration. Three set-cookie values on the MCP responses are redacted in the artifact as session cookies; nothing here depends on them.

finding: Twenty days on, the four anonymous requests of the 2026-09-20 record answer the same way, now with a transcript: the merchant's well-known document names UCP version 2026-08-25 and one MCP shopping endpoint; a bare tools/list answers 200 with the same thirteen tools; an anonymous create_checkout carrying the vendor's example agent profile and an impossible variant id is not refused for want of a credential and passes through to merchandise validation, answering 200 with isError true and a UCP envelope whose one message is 'The merchandise with id gid://shopify/ProductVariant/0 does not exist'; and the control, get_order with the same arguments, answers 403 AuthenticationRequired before any argument is read. The vendor's pages still disagree about whether checkout tools need a credential (the tier table says the Anonymous tier may use checkout tools; the Cart and Checkout MCP pages say authentication is required), and this measures the narrower thing measured in September: the credential gate did not stop an anonymous create_checkout, and stopped get_order. The discovery document today lists ten capability keys where the September record named six; when that changed is not measured.

reproducibility.command: E=https://1da1f2-7c.myshopify.com/api/ucp/mcp;A='{"meta":{"ucp-agent":{"profile":"https://shopify.dev/ucp/agent-profiles/examples/2026-08-25/valid-with-capabilities.json"}},"checkout":{"currency":"USD","line_items":[{"quantity":1,"item":{"id":"gid://shopify/ProductVariant/0"}}]}}';c(){ curl -sSD- -X POST $E -H'content-type: application/json' -d"{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":1,\"method\":\"$1\",\"params\":$2}";};curl -s https://hardware.shopify.com/.well-known/ucp;c tools/list {};for t in create_checkout get_order;do c tools/call "{\"name\":\"$t\",\"arguments\":$A}";done
